integrity: The mathematical proof is independent of finite tests; all arithmetic test cases are explicitly bounded. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Index-one, prime-to-characteristic exponents only; no extension to proper power subgroups or larger subset size. Explicit general character formulas predate this sharp small-size positivity classification. Original full texts for the two Ding–Zhou papers were not accessible, leaving an originality risk.
title: Sharp three-term additive coverage by distinct power values in index-one Galois rings
